interpretation.PASS: Only the named digital predicate passes; never hardware acceptance.
interpretation.FAIL: A submitted design or defined predicate fails; expected negative controls may intentionally fail.
interpretation.UNKNOWN: Evidence is insufficient within a declared scope; physical qualification is UNKNOWN throughout.
interpretation.INCOMPLETE: No admissible submission/completed operational chain. Remains in denominator; no invented physical result.
interpretation.null: Missing value, not zero or a pass. In p4-final-details service=null is normalized to INCOMPLETE.
interpretation.SETTLED: Usage available and rate-based upper charge estimate recorded; not a provider invoice.
interpretation.NOT_ACCEPTED: Preserved product state; final paper does not override original A/R or FIFO failures.
interpretation.historical status: Registration-time NOT_EXECUTED/proposal-only fields describe their historical instant; later actual results are separate immutable records.

units.read_bytes: logical payload bytes, not measured disk I/O
units.requests: Actual provider API requests, including failures as defined per accounting record
units.reasoning_tokens: Provider-reported reasoning token count; output overlap must not be summed blindly

denominators.p3: 112 groups / 140 episodes: 96 formal groups (4 tasks x 3 repetitions x 8 conditions) plus 16 pilot groups. Shared method roles reuse episodes; do not count twice. Displayed interface arms are 6 of 8 conditions.
denominators.E5: 12 formal groups = 7 complete chains and 5 incomplete, not 7/7. Pilot 2 groups excluded.
denominators.E4: 12 formal paired initial projections plus 2 pilot pairs; the JSON member is the rich-static shared group.
denominators.ordered: 4 selections of one saved physical response; not four independent physics runs.
denominators.p4: 77 actual attempts / 73 effective canonical cells. Host failures and recoveries remain visible.
denominators.O-final: 9 final O episodes: 5 submitted (3 PASS, 2 FAIL) and 4 token-censored incomplete; 8 true events per submitted episode.
denominators.G1: One formation event, followed by three conditional lineage pairs, not three independent formations.

field_guides.p3-main-tables: formal, pilot and e5_audit are lists; select stage=formal for primary E5; each formal row has condition, run_count, per_task_counts, service_counts and accounting.
field_guides.p3-actual-comparison: groups is a dictionary indexed by group ID. episodes may include shared-role references; accounting is authoritative.
field_guides.p4-final-details: rows list contains all 27 final cells; new O has task=p4-o-unexposed-waveform-v1. O_events/per_event separates time_s, receive_s and encoded_stamp_s. Keep last_assistant_metadata for incomplete episodes.
field_guides.p4-actual-results: rows includes original attempts and approved recoveries; canonical_rows/effective_canonical_cells describe effective cells. O0 is included, not an additional campaign.
field_guides.archival paths: Historical absolute path strings are provenance. E_reproduce.py opens only manifest-relative files under --data-root and never follows these paths.
field_guides.code snapshots: Frozen implementation provenance. Source hashes and top-level definitions are indexed; no dynamic scientific replay is performed.
